team_conditional_modifiers_json.description: R5 Viper's Ballad: three Elemental Skill / Burst hits (0.03s ICD, so one multi-hit cast) convert Hymn of the Pure into Thus Lied the Viper: nearby party members deal +48% Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG for 12s (umbrella key, both Stellar reactions), during which no new stacks accrue. Works off-field. Team scope: reaches the wielder and everyone else.

source.note: 7.1 weapon, added 2026-09-22 (release day) from nanoka 7.1 data; neither Amber nor GO carry it yet. Base stats derived as init x levels['90'] + last ascension add (the derivation validated against the existing seed files for the 7.0 batch). Buffs baked at R5 (house convention: 4* at R5, 5* at R1). The unconditional +40% ER is in self_modifiers_json.
